references.text: Psalm 133:1 highlights unity among God's people, which resonates with the idea of agreement in prayer in Matthew 18:19.
Isaiah 65:24 speaks of God answering before people call, similar to the promise of answered prayer in Matthew 18:19.
Acts 1:14 shows the disciples gathered together in unity in prayer, reflecting the principle of agreement in Matthew 18:19.
Hebrews 4:16 encourages coming boldly before God's throne, which can be seen in connection with the promise of answered prayer in Matthew 18:19.
